description: This PHP source file defines the AddDataGroupCommand class, a console command for adding data groups within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for configuring command arguments and options, interacting with the user to gather input, and executing the command to create data groups and associated API permissions, along with printing SQL statements and tables for verification.

classes.name: AddDataGroupCommand
classes.description: A Symfony Console command class for adding data groups and associated API permissions in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command description, arguments, and options for the console command.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the command with SymfonyStyle for user interactions.

methods.name: interact
methods.description: Handles interactive prompts to gather data group information and API permission details from the user.

methods.name: getModuleAutocompleteQuestion
methods.description: Returns a Question object with autocompletion for module names.

methods.name: notBlankValidation
methods.description: Validates that a given input string is not blank.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method for the command; creates DataGroup and ApiPermission entities, prints SQL and tables, and handles simulated runs.

methods.name: printDataGroupTable
methods.description: Outputs a table displaying details of the created DataGroup.

methods.name: printDataGroupSQL
methods.description: Outputs sample SQL insert statements for the DataGroup.

methods.name: printApiPermissionTable
methods.description: Outputs a table with details of the created ApiPermission.

methods.name: printApiPermissionSQL
methods.description: Outputs sample SQL statements to insert ApiPermission.

methods.name: printBlock
methods.description: Utility method to output a block of text in the console.
